'''Mianloong Chamber''' is the seventh act in [[Chapter I]] of the [[Main Quests]].

==Summary==
You learn about Jinhsi's past. Jinhsi is adamant about fulfilling her duty. The prophesied battle between her and the Sentinel was meant for the distant future, but she is willing to confront the Sentinel now if it is the only way to keep everyone safe. She expresses her gratitude for your companionship.

Upon entering the Mianloong Chamber, you find a body of water frozen in time. Can you walk across the water's surface to get to the other side?

On the summit of Mt. Firmament, Jué waits in the Sonoro Sphere for a challenger. Jinzhou's fate is in Jinhsi's hands, and she will fight for it in her own way. You support her decision and open the door to the Sonoro Sphere, ready to witness this key moment in Jinzhou's history.

==Steps==
# Inspect the hibernation pod
# Operate the Chronosorter to adjust the water level
# Approach and activate the Flare Stone to put out the Flare Crest (Part One)
# Approach and activate the Flare Stone to put out the Flare Crest (Part Two)
# Check the file
# Operate the Chronosorter
# Levitate the [[Tacetite Fulminate]]
# Use the Tacetite Fulminate to destroy the [[Fissured Ledge]]
# Approach and activate the Flare Stone to put out the Flare Crest (Part Two)
# Use the Tacetite Fulminate to destroy the [[Fissured Ledge]]
# Approach and activate the Flare Stone to put out the Flare Crest (Part Three)
# Return to Mianloong Chamber and inspect the hibernation pod

:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_1_001.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_1_002.ogg}} '''Jinhsi & Narrator:''' ...Once Tacet Discords terrorized the land. The region of Jinzhou was under siege.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_2.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' A mother and her newborn child were hiding in ruins, trying to avoid the deadly creatures
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_3.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' They weren't safe for long as the Tacet Discords found them. The mother sacrificed herself to protect her child
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_4.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' ...but with her gone, it was difficult for the newborn to survive. In a couple minutes, its loud cries gradually died out 
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_5.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' Fortunately, the newborn's cries echoed through the forest, with a unique resonance that reached the ears of the mighty Sentinel
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_6.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' With a burst of energy, our Sentinel dispelled the surrounding evils
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_7.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' But sadly, it was too late
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_8.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' That night, Mt. Firmament shook with the roars of a Loong, and dark clouds gathered. The Sentinel returned with a dead infant in its embrace
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_9.ogg}} '''Narrator:''' As if by magic, somber clouds parted and shooting stars lit up the sky. With Mt. Firmament's unique flow of time, the Sentinel brought the deceased infant back to life
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_10_001.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_355_10_002.ogg}} '''Jinhsi & Narrator:''' The resurrected infant became known as the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator, and went on to become the Magistrate of Jinzhou...
;(Cutscene ends)

:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_1.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} The "deceased infant" here, is it...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_3.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Yes... It's me.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_4.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I've lived in Jinzhou my whole life and never ventured into Hongzhen, yet even I know of the legend.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_5.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' To me, Jué is more than just our Sentinel or a revered divine being... It raised me and saved me from certain death.      
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_6.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I've been thinking about it on our way here.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_7.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' If the Sentinel predicted our fight, why would it even bother saving me in the first place?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_8.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Now I understand why. Because I am the Sentinel's Resonator. I may not have any extraordinary abilities, but I do possess the Temporal Program that it accidentally lost.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_9.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' If Jinzhou ever faces a similar time crisis, I... I might be the only one who can set things right.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_10.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...In our Sentinel's prediction, the battle between us is supposed to happen in the distant future.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_11.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' It had been waiting for an opportunity, a right moment to tell me the truth. That's why it didn't explain.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_12.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Now may not be the opportunity the Sentinel has been waiting for, but my body cannot hold up much longer...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_13.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I have to go and face it while I still can... to learn about the truth, or complete our destined battle.
:{{DIcon}} You can still give up.
:{{DIcon}} As your friend, I don't want to see you suffer.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_16.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Give up... my duty? I never thought about it...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_17.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' To be honest... I did doubt myself many times.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_18.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' It was the endless kindness of you, Changli, Xinyi, and everyone in Jinzhou that gave me the courage to push on.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_19.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Even Jué's decision to bring me back to life... Whether out of pity or not, I am truly grateful. The thought of it warms my heart every time.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_20.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Jinzhou holds everything that's dear to me. Even without the title of Magistrate, I could never leave Jinzhou behind.    
:{{DIcon}} But your wounds...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_22.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I'm okay...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_23.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' The pain I'm feeling is nothing compared to those trapped in the Temporal Disruptions.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_24.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I must find the Sentinel as soon as possible. We draw from the same source of power—saving it means saving myself.       
:{{DIcon}} Do you have to fight the Sentinel?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_26.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' If there is truly no other option in the end...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_27.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Then I will have to fight it. I refuse to back down.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_28.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I will fight. To protect the Sentinel, and to defend Jinzhou. One life may be lost, but many will be saved.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_29.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' If it means keeping everyone safe, then I have no regrets giving my own life.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_30.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' But let me make one thing clear—I am not planning on dying yet. I am here to fight for a chance at survival, no matter how slim that chance may be.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_42.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' We're not in a situation where death is our only option, are we? 
:{{DIcon}} I trust your decision.
:{{DIcon}} I will help you.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_33.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Thank you for placing your trust in me.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_34.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Come to think of it, many good things have happened to me since you arrived in Jinzhou.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_35.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Thank you, {{Rover}}.
:{{DIcon}} I am always here for you.
:{{DIcon}} I'll make sure you turn out safe.
:{{DIcon}} I'll go meet the Sentinel with you.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_39.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' My teacher Changli told me it's up to both of us to solve the crisis at Mt. Firmament. As I know you have a special connection with our Sentinel, I need your support in this decision.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_40.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' But don't worry, I'm prepared. This isn't about succumbing to destiny, it's about embracing it fully.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_360_41.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I am grateful to have you by my side through it all.

:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_1.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Jinhsi, it has been quite some time.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_2_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_2_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' And greetings, {{MC|m=Lord|f=Lady}} Arbiter. Or should one address you as "Rover" now?  
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_3.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' One cannot discern the cause of your arrival, yet its significance heralds Jinzhou's fateful juncture.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_4.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Shall a "child" who has lost their memories take up arms and fight for their fate? Or shall they retreat to their cradle and slumber?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_5.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' The seed of the future shall be sown in this very moment.
:{{DIcon}} What do you mean by "Arbiter"? What should I do?
:{{DIcon}} I don't understand. Care to explain again?   
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_8.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Once the situation settles, an explanation shall be provided. For now, one must implore you to simply engage, decide, and observe.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_9.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Jinhsi, your journey has been an arduous one. Aside from aiding one in this predicament, surely there are other inquiries you wish to make?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_10.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I cannot bring myself to ask for more. All I seek is the truth.  
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_11.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Mt. Firmament is in grave danger... Regarding the Temporal Mandate and your injuries... Please, do not keep the truth from me any longer.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_12.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' One understands your concerns. The timing may not be optimal for this disclosure, yet in the midst of crisis, one must act with expedience.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_13.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' For one will soon perish.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_14.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_15.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' One such as this, of immortal nature, is designed to endure for all time.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_16.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Yet one suffered severe harm in ancient times, and now relies on the Mianloong Chamber for survival.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_17.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' This is not the optimal solution.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_18.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' For a long time, one has had to use this chamber to replenish energy, hoping to delay the inevitable doom.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_19.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Yet fate cannot be defied. The Fractsidus have conspired against this one. Now, the injury only worsens... The Mianloong Chamber can no longer prolong one's life.
:{{DIcon}} If you die, what will happen to Jinzhou?     
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_21_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_21_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Jinzhou... The city of Jinzhou will be no more.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_22_M.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ... <!--Should we rename the audio name? The original name has "_M", no "_F", but there's only one version of the audio-->
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_23_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_23_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Ever since one descended upon Mt. Firmament, using the power of Temporal Mandate to repel Tacet Discords, time has been in disarray within this location. The fate of Jinzhou was sealed from that moment on.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_24_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_24_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Over the past millenia, one has defied the laws of nature and sustained Jinzhou at the cost of one's own life force.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_25_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_25_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Otherwise, the Temporal Disruption would wreak havoc not only on Mt. Firmament, but on the entire region of Jinzhou. If this were to happen, all life will be engulfed in a chaotic storm of twisted time flow.
:{{DIcon}} What would happen to them?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_27_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_27_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Jinzhou shall forever remain frozen in time. The past and the future meld into one, rendering life indistinguishable from death. The ceremonial rituals and endless battles persist, intertwining joy and sorrow into an eternal blur.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_28_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_28_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' All inhabitants of Jinzhou shall endure this perpetual fate until time itself ceases to exist.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_29_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_29_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' ...It is this one's own doing, and one must put an end to it.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_30.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' In the coming days, one will exert every ounce of strength to freeze the time in Jinzhou at the cost of one's remaining life.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_31.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' In that moment, Jinzhou will fall into stillness, but not perish. In the distant future, the people of Huanglong may discover a method to rescue Jinzhou.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_32.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Is there truly nothing else we can do?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_33.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' This is not the optimal solution, but it suffices as an option.   
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_34.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Please forgive me... but I cannot do as you say.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_35.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' A decade, a century... What if nobody comes up with a solution? By that time, the world will have turned its back on this forgotten city...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_36.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...And who would be willing to spend precious resources rescuing a small city in a far-off corner of the world?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_37.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Jinzhou's fate deserves better than an uncertain future.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_38.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Whilst one may not live to witness the future, one can still envision endless possibilities yet to come. In my deduction, this method proves to be the most effective and stable. 
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_39.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Magistrate Jinhsi, as you express doubts, pray tell how do you propose to solve this issue?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_40.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' The flow of time upon Mt. Firmament is in disarray, and it can only be contained through one's utmost effort.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_41.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' If one does not freeze the time now, the situation in Jinzhou shall surely worsen a hundredfold, or even a thousandfold, after one's passing.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_42.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ..You once predicted a destined battle between us... Is it true? 
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_43.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Correct.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_44.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...I was lost at first, struggling to grasp the prophecy's meaning. Only when I learned of your actions alongside the Court of Savantae did it all become clear—
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_45.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' By clashing two resonating powers, a Second Resonance Awakening can be induced. Through this, I am able to push my Resonance Ability beyond its limits and invoke the Temporal Mandate to restore the flow of time.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_48.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...Though I will be forced to raise my blade against you...      
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_49.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' RIDICULOUS!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_50.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' If you clash with my resonance power, even the smallest mistake will result in Overclocking and leave you nothing but an empty husk.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_51.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' You are well aware of its excruciating effects. The pain you feel now is but a faint scratch in comparison to its true torment.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_52.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Moreover, you will be trapped within the fissures of time itself. Your being will be relentlessly shredded and mended, day after day, denied any respite for eternity.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_53.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' But I can restore the errors in the flow of time. Isn't that why you saved me all those years ago? I'm just doing what you've been doing all along... Going against fate to keep Jinzhou safe.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_54.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Jinhsi, you are given one last opportunity. Let me freeze the time, and I can ensure your safety.
:{{DIcon}} There must be another way.
:{{DIcon}} What if I help her? I am here for a reason.  
:{{DIcon}} Is there really no chance for her to live?   
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_58.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' You are only here to witness before the <i>right time</i> arrives.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_59.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' But you are not compelled to remain idle. Should you intervene, we may augment Jinhsi's odds of survival by a fraction.   
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_60.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Command me to transfer my Temporal Mandate access to Jinhsi at the right moment.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_61.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' —The moment of her Resonance Ability's depletion, when she is teetering on the brink of Overclocking and near death. Then, we may still save her life.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_380_62.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Miss that moment by even the slightest margin, and Jinhsi's fate will be sealed.
:{{DIcon}} I will do everything I can to keep Jinhsi safe.
:{{DIcon}} So a fight between you two is unavoidable.
----
;(Cutscene plays)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_1.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...I should have died a long time ago... but I was lucky enough to be saved by you, allowing me the chance to see the glittering lights of Jinzhou for myself.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_2.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' ...You rewinded time to save me. I am responsible.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_3.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Jinzhou is my home. If it's ever in danger, I will do everything in my power to protect what I hold dear, even at the cost of my own life.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_4.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Such a valiant speech!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_5.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Do you know the weight of this decision?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_6.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I understand your concerns. I will reach my Second Awakening with our destined confrontation, and restore the time flow.  
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_7.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Are you willing to bet on me?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_21.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Restore the time flow? Pray, from where does this confidence arise?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_8.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' You are my Resonator, but your strength is only a fraction of mine.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_9.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' There is little chance for you to retreat unscathed.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_10.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' But I can at least win some hope for our people!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_11.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Even if it costs me my soul, my everything... I cannot die without trying.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_12.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I may only bear your power for a fleeting moment... It's all I need to secure a better future for Jinzhou, defying all of your predictions. And I can keep you safe.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_383_13.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' If there is anyone who can face you in a fight...That person has to be your Resonator.
